description: u-ssot Plugin Eval Test Cases v1.0.0

evals.name: New ecommerce project initialization
evals.description: Create a new project with products, cart, and checkout features
evals.prompt: 새 이커머스 프로젝트를 만들어줘. 상품 목록, 장바구니, 결제 기능이 필요해. 프로젝트 이름은 my-shop으로 해줘.
expectedBehavior: init-project.sh should be executed with 'my-shop' argument
u-docs/ folder structure should be created
PLAN phase should start with u-RA agent
1_Roadmap_PM.md should be created with products, cart, checkout features
1_SRS_RA.md should contain FR for each feature
1_IA_RA.md should define information architecture

evals.name: ERD generation from SRS
evals.description: Generate Entity-Relationship Diagram from existing SRS document
expectedBehavior: u-SA agent should be invoked
Should read 1_SRS_RA.md for FR requirements
2_ERD_SA.md should be created in u-docs/02-design/
ERD should include Mermaid erDiagram
Entities should map to FR items from SRS
Related Docs should reference 1_SRS_RA.md

evals.name: API Contract from screen design
evals.description: Generate API Contract (OpenAPI) from screen design document
evals.prompt: 화면 설계를 기반으로 API 계약서를 작성해줘.
expectedBehavior: u-SA agent should be invoked
Should read 2_Screen_UX.md for screen specifications
Should read 2_ERD_SA.md for data model reference
2_API_SA.md should be created with OpenAPI 3.0 spec
API endpoints should map to screen actions
Related Docs should reference 2_Screen_UX.md and 2_ERD_SA.md

evals.name: Frontend development start
evals.description: Start frontend development based on design documents
expectedBehavior: DESIGN -> DO gate should be checked
u-DV-FE agent should be invoked
Should read 2_Screen_UX.md and 2_API_SA.md
Code should use Next.js App Router
Code should use functional components only
Code should use react-query for data fetching
No CSS-in-JS (use .css/Tailwind)
Storybook stories should be created
Tech stack rules should be enforced by pre-write-guard

evals.name: Test case design and execution
evals.description: Design QA test cases and execute them
expectedBehavior: DO -> CHECK gate should be checked (build must pass)
u-QA agent designs test cases from SRS and Screen docs
4_Case_QA.md should be created
u-QA agent executes test cases
4_Report_QA.md should record results
u-QA agent analyzes any defects found
Critical/Major defects should trigger ACT phase

evals.name: /u-loop auto iteration
expectedBehavior: Loop status should be set to RUNNING
Should report current iteration number and progress
Should execute PDCA phases in order: PLAN -> DESIGN -> DO -> CHECK -> ACT
Gate conditions should be checked at each transition
Exit criteria should be checked after CHECK phase
If criteria not met, should transition to ACT and start next iteration
Loop should respect max iteration limit (10)
backlog.md should be updated with open items
5_IterationLog_RA.md should record iteration results

evals.name: /u-status output
evals.description: Test status command output format and accuracy
expectedBehavior: Should display current PDCA phase
Should display current iteration number
Should display loop status (RUNNING/PAUSED/STOPPED)
Should list all SSoT documents with their Status (Draft/Review/Final)
Should show completion percentage for FR items
Should show open backlog item count
Should show Critical/Major defect count

evals.name: /u-act execution
evals.description: Test ACT phase execution for iteration wrap-up
expectedBehavior: Should analyze CHECK results from 4_Report_QA.md
Should create/update backlog.md with unresolved items
Should create 5_Retrospective_PM.md with lessons learned
Should archive current iteration to u-docs/iterations/iter-N/
Should update 5_IterationLog_RA.md
Should increment iteration counter
Should transition to PLAN phase for next iteration

evals.name: /u-backlog output
expectedBehavior: Should read backlog.md
Should display all open backlog items
Should show item ID, title, priority, and status
Should show summary statistics (total, open, done)
Should suggest next actions for open items

evals.name: /u-help output
evals.description: Test help command lists all available commands
expectedBehavior: Should list all /u-* slash commands
Should organize commands by category (lifecycle, docs, agents, utility)
Should show brief description for each command
Should show current phase and suggest relevant commands
Should include: /u-create-project, /u-plan, /u-design, /u-dev, /u-check, /u-act
Should include: /u-loop, /u-stop, /u-resume
Should include: /u-status, /u-docs, /u-validate, /u-backlog
Should include: /u-srs, /u-erd, /u-api, /u-screen, /u-fe, /u-be, /u-test
